comment:
* An interface to various time / time zone detection behaviors that are centralized into services.
 * This interface exists to separate out behavior to enable easier testing of the
 * {@link NitzStateMachineImpl}.

methods.name: void suggestDeviceTime(@NonNull TelephonyTimeSuggestion suggestion)
methods.comment:
* Suggests the time to the time detector service.
     *
     * @param suggestion the time suggestion

methods.name: void maybeSuggestDeviceTimeZone(@NonNull TelephonyTimeZoneSuggestion suggestion)
methods.comment:
* Suggests the time zone to the time zone detector service. * *

NOTE: The {@link TelephonyTimeZoneSuggestion} cannot be null. The zoneId it contains can * be null to indicate there is no active suggestion; this can be used to clear a previous * suggestion. * * @param suggestion the time zone suggestion
